notes.title: The Hive Advances, Bug Fixes, MVP Player
notes.notes:
The Hive Continues its Advance
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31330306/3ca98691653b262a2ae483e239b6e6880766a804.jpg
A Behemoth in the Hive Nest
Most players are enjoying the radically different Hive race that debut on this server; The Hive is especially strong when players work together and 'swarm' a sector.  They now control 25% of the map, and they did have the smallest starting territory.  There's already a Behemoth in action...  Since this is Hive PvE, the Hive has some starting buffs that would not normally be on future servers.  

The 'Move Bug' Eliminated
An annoying bug that plagued many players (especially those who had lagging internet connections) was the 'Move Bug'.  It happens when a player would desynch (client) from the server, at the same time they were giving move commands coinciding with the transit phase.  It would make their ship freeze in place, and the only thing they could do was to warp out.  Fixed now.

MVP Player of the Month
Congrats to Jerbear, who won the MVP Player of the Month for February.  He chose the unique ship of Leningrad with a special evasion skill, colored in a dark blue state.  He will be the only player to have access to the ship.  Jerbear has been playing since December 14th, 2018, and has participated in 8 servers so far.  His favorite race is Sol Imperial Worlds.

notes.title: SpaceWars Update V1.15
notes.notes:
NEW SHIPS
Mobile Repair Facilities

Though repair tenders (both Class IV Frigate and Class V Destroyer) are commonly used and quite popular, there has been work done on creating tenders that can support heavy repair bays.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31330306/50deaca84a2c1a41b9f8f80734cdd976a7f2afe5.jpg
POLARIS MOBILE REPAIR FACILITY (SOL IMPERIAL WORLDS)
As the Sol-Genari wars escalated with large scale conflicts between Cruisers and other capital ships, the need for a more comprehensive repair tender was needed.   Rear Admiral West, the original proponent of the Klondike pushed high command for a tender that could support repair bays found on stations that worked exclusively on capital ships.    Such a massive repair station would require a cruiser's superstructure to support, and even then it could not support a larger force field because of the mass requirements.   The Rear Admiral found it to be  invaluable however, as his fleet of Long Range Beam cruisers could fire at range, with  these tenders stationed behind moons or asteroids, ready to take in any Capital ship for repairs in the field without being forced to leave the region.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31330306/ee4d4f55d16ffc6a10ccfd9c9297e9d444f50101.jpg
FAT GENSHAI MOBILE REPAIR FACILITY (GENARI UNITED EMPIRE)
This oversized repair tender was purpose-built more as a defensive repair station that would occupy captured Sol regions after a successful Genari campaign.  Very slow and unwieldy, it tends to move short distances in preparation of a Sol counterattack.   Designed to repair capital ships, it also has 120 marines available to resupply ships with marine pods similar to the Destiny Troop Ships' role.    Because of the size of the large repair bays and engines needed to propel a ship of this size, there was no space to give this ship proper weapons systems.    As Fleet Commanders get used to this mobile repair facility, they've come to find it invaluable in important defensive operations.

NOTE:  Capital Ship Commander skill required to operate these ships.

notes.title: SpaceWars Update V1.09
notes.notes:
Two New Ship Variants

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31330306/298d21daef039fab5f95a1ec118622d01be0400e.jpg

SOL
Oslo Combat/Support Hybrid 
Class IV Frigate
The Oslo shows its age considerably in the late 22nd century, as it was very unpopular with commanders fighting at the border, aiming for the far superior Gorshkov and Liverpool frigates.   Rear Admiral  Musashi decided to refit some of the underused Oslo ships with repair bays, so that they became sturdy support ships for the front line.  Unfortunately two of the beams had to be removed for the repair bay, but they were upgraded to the most powerful LB-9 type lasers which could put out significant damage if fully charged.
This rare variant of the Oslo is the only combat warship with repair support capabilities.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31330306/f703b38b7351b52eb9da02761c9d7f9937ef5b89.jpg

GENARI
Predator Missile Ship
Class IV Frigate
On the surface, this seems to be the same Predator Frigate that the Talagh Matriarchy used as the mainstay of the their fleet.   Some were modified however; with the beams removed and replaced with similarly-powered missiles.   The power to damage ratio was improved, as well as the shield generator to the second generation variant.   With slightly reduced armor, it is not considered superior to the original Predator, but is popular with many captains for its missile loadout.

notes.title: SpaceWars Early Access Beta Update v1.06
notes.notes:
•	The Commandeer mechanic has been improved, so when a Sol ship is commandeered by Genari other Sol ships will now be able to fire upon the commandeered ship.  If the commandeered ship is destroyed before leaving the map no bonus XP will be awarded to Genari players. Genari players will no longer be able to attack a commandeered Sol ship.  Commandeered Sol ship scanners and detection now functions as if it were a Genari ship.
•	The Marine Commander skills Commandeer are now available.
	Commandeer I: Captured ships will take 1 turn less to warp out of a map. The successful exfiltration of a commandeered ship awards 4X the destruction XP instead of 2X.
	Commandeer II: Captured ships will take 2 turns less to warp out of a map. The successful exfiltration of a commandeered ship awards 8X the destruction XP instead of 2X.
•	Advanced Med Bays skills for the Sol Medical Officer have had their healing modifiers reduced.
	Advanced Med Bays I: 5% Crew Healing per round
	Advanced Med Bays II: 10% Crew Healing per round
•	The ship skill Improved Rotation has been implemented and is now available on all Gorshkov and Starfire variants.  This skill is functionally the same and will not stack with the Rotation officer skill.
•	A server greeting message system has been added to the game.  When a player loads into the Spacedock for the first time during a play session they will be presented with a message tailored to the specific server.
•	A New Player server is now available. This server is meant as a place for learning to play the game in a limited fashion.  Ships are limited to Class 4 Frigates and lower, and all variants can be unlocked for LP/HP (No Credits Required). Once players are ready to play in a competitive environment they can create a character the main server.

notes.title: SpaceWars Early Access Beta Update v1.05
notes.notes:
-	The Commandeer game mechanic is now in-game.  Firing a Marine Pod that reduces a ship’s crew to zero will result in the marines taking over the ship and attempting to escape the map with the ship.  Due to the covert operations of the Marines’ operations, other Genari players will not be aware that a ship has been commandeered and will still be able to fire upon the ship.  When a commandeered ship leaves the map double experience will be awarded to all Genari players in the map with the majority of the experience going to the player who captured the ship.  The interaction for Sol players whose ships are commandeered will function the same as if their ship was destroyed with it going on cooldown if it isn’t a starter ship. The Commandeer skills for the Marine Commandeer will remain disabled for the time being.
-	A new product to double the LP/HP a player earns is now available in the Shipyard.  Upon purchase all HP/LP a player earns for 24 hours will be doubled. The LP/HP bars on the Spacedock and Galaxy Map will have a visual effect when the bonus is active.  The time remaining will be displayed on the LP/HP doubler product on the Shipyard. Purchasing multiple of these at one time will extend the duration HP/LP will be doubled.
-	The Ship Glossary is now having its information dynamically populated so it will always be up to date with any design changes to ships and structures.
-	The chat bar will now be open by default.
-	The Genari captain skill Rally Offensive will now be refreshed upon returning to the shipyard after a ship’s destruction.
-	Players will now be able to correctly move in reverse with the Rotation skill if they have less than 2 or more but less than 3 movement points remaining.
-	The number of times a captain can be respecced has been increased to 6.

notes.title: SpaceWars Early Access Update v1.02
notes.notes:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31330306/7a5337fc09545e302ad81ef93c2cd3c910ba55ca.jpg

•	Made some visual adjustments to the variant buttons on the Shipyard.
•	Added a new feature that allows us to set a Honor/Leadership point bonus that is awarded to the player upon creating a character for a specific faction.
•	The sector lockout for retreating is now per captain instead of per ship.
•	Fixed several issues with not being able to get credit for defending sectors.  Sector defense is now counted if a player is of the defending faction and is in the map when it shifts from combat to freeflight due to an enemy ship’s destruction or retreat. Sector defense can only be rewarded once per sector.  The per sector restriction is reset upon docking with a friendly Spacedock.
•	Players will now be able to adjust power levels to damaged systems during the allocation phase.
•	Ship systems (weapons, shield arcs, scanners, and marine pods) will no longer have their power automatically deallocated when damaged.

notes.title: SpaceWars Early Access Beta Update v0.19
notes.notes:
-Added a new sector isolation feature to the game.  When one or more sectors which do not contain structures are no longer directly connected to a shipyard via other sectors of the same faction they will be identified as isolated.  When a sector becomes isolated a timer will begin and if it is still isolated when the timer hits 0 the sector(s) will switch control over to the opposing faction.  Locked sectors will not be considered as isolated until after the lock is removed.
-The ability to delete characters has been disabled for the remainder of this server season.
-Addressed an issue regarding the AI that would result in server performance issues over an extended period of time.
-Fixed a visual issue where the faction icons were incorrectly flipped on the siege bar for multimap sectors.
-The XP earned from capturing and defending sectors has been doubled.
-The siege points earned for destroying stations and defense platforms has been increased:  
   Class XIII: 50 points
   Class XII: 40 points
   Class XI: 30 points
   Class X: 20 points
   Under Class X: 10 points

notes.title: SpaceWars Early Access Beta Update v0.18
notes.notes:
-Players will now be able to correctly attack and capture individual maps in multimap sectors in the correct progression order. The defending faction will be able to counter-attack captured maps to regain control in the reverse order of the attackers. When all maps in the sector are owned by the attackers the sector with lock and change ownership.
Note: There is a known visual issue where the faction icons can be incorrectly flipped on the siege bar when the map is captured by the attacker but the sector is still owned by the defender.
-The defending faction for contested sectors will now slowly recover siege points if there are no enemies in the map.
-Fixed an issue with the ship skill Radiation Resistant not functioning. It functions in the same manner as the officer skill Resistance 1 but will not stack.
-Fixed an issue where Hive shipyards were not properly appearing on the galaxy map.
-Fixed an issue where the Hive were not reinforcing their sectors when attacked by Genari or Sol.
-Activating Stress Engines during the allocation phase will result in the ship’s weapons being disabled during the following combat phase.
-Player will now be blocked from entering a sector if a support ship in their fleet exceeds the max class allowed in the sector.

notes.title: SpaceWars Early Access Beta Update v0.17
notes.notes:
-Players now have the ability to sell their ships from the Ship Details or Shipyard section of the Spacedock.  40% of the Honor/Leadership point cost for the ship will be refunded to the player upon its sale.  All officers and their levels/skills on a ship that is sold will be lost.
-All sectors that contain a shipyard (EG: Earth) have had their faction limits doubled.
-The Evasive V skill for the Helmsman has had its modifier reduced to 25% from 30%.
-The ship skill Genari Monolith has had its modifier reduce to 5% from 10%.
-Leaving a map while still in combat will incur a retreat penalty preventing the player from re-entering that same sector with the same ship for a 30 minute period. The time remaining will appear on the disabled engage button.
-Repair ships will now generate XP for the player piloting only when another ship uses the repair points given to repair.
-Repairing one’s own ship now prioritizes using one’s own repair points before using those given by a repair ship.
-Sectors now have restrictions for specific ship classes that are allowed to enter.
    Sectors with a Faction Limit of 6 and lower can now only support Class I-IV ships.
    Sectors with a Faction Limit of 9 and lower can now only support Class I-VI ships.
    Sectors with a Faction Limit of 11 and lower can now only support Class I-VIII ships.
    Sectors with a Faction Limit of 12 and higher have no ship class restrictions.
-AI Reinforcement ships will now remain in a sector for a longer amount of time before leaving.
-All ships (Player, Support, Fleet Commander, AI Reinforcement, and NPC Civilian) will now be properly represented on the Sector Details on the Galaxy Map.
-Medical, Repair, and Troop ships that are the player’s primary ship not following as a support ship will now count towards the faction limit of a sector.
-Fleet commander ships will no longer follow support ships if piloted by a player.

notes.title: SpaceWars Early Access Beta Update v0.15 + Permadeath Removal
notes.notes:
Permadeath Removal
A lot of players found the game too hardcore; and wanted something less punishing if they lost their ships.  All higher tier ships from Class IV to Class X now get returned to you intact with current officer upgrades, but with the ship in 'cooldown' period from 3-7 days depending on the tier.

Permanent death on all class 4 and above ships including their officers has been removed and replaced with a cooldown timer.  Once destroyed the ship will go on cooldown in the player’s roster for a set amount of time depending on its class. Permanent death on all class 1-3 ships is still active but they have no cooldown.
Class 4-5: 2 days 12 hours
Class 6: 2 days 21 hours
Class 7: 3 days 11 hours
Class 8: 4 days
Class 9-10: 4 days 15 hours

-The Genari captain skill Honorable Death will now reduce the cooldown duration of ships by a percentage amount based on the skill tier.
Honorable Death I: reduces the cooldown by 30%
Honorable Death II:  reduces the cooldown by 60%

-The Sol officer skill Emergency Escape will now reduce the cooldown duration of ships by a percentage amount based on the skill tier.
Emergency Escape I - reduces the cooldown by 10%
Emergency Escape II - reduces the cooldown by 20%
Emergency Escape III - reduces the cooldown by 30%
Emergency Escape IV - reduces the cooldown by 40%
Emergency Escape V - reduces the cooldown by 60%

-Travel to isolated friendly sectors from an enemy controlled sector is no longer permitted.
-New Sol and Genari premium captain portraits have been added to the game.
-Fixed an issue where unopposed would be incorrectly triggered in combat resulting in gradual depletion of the defender’s siege points.
-The game will now do a better job handling resolution of combat if there is a ship in transit.
-Overhauled the leaderboard to address several issues with displaying information.

-Each ship class now has a specified faction value that contributes to the faction limit for a sector. The values are:
Class 1-3 Ships = 1
Class 4 Ships = 2
Class 5-6 Ships = 3
Class 7-8 Ships = 4
Class 9-10 Ships = 5
If a sector has reached the max combined ship value for a given faction players of that faction will no longer be able to travel to that region instead of entering the queue.
